task_completion.description: Fetch 1OMP and 1ANF from PDB and remove solvent/heteroatoms.
task_completion.visual_evidence: PyMOL object list showing '1OMP' and '1ANF' (or similar names) with no red dots (water) or non-polymer spheres/sticks visible in the viewport.

task_completion.description: Align the two protein structures to a common reference frame.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL viewport shows the two protein structures overlapping/superimposed rather than being far apart in space.

task_completion.description: Generate a 30-state morph trajectory between the two states.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new object (likely named 'morph' or 'm1') appears in the object list, and the PyMOL playback slider at the bottom shows 30 frames/states.

task_completion.description: Save the morph PDB and the superposition image to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or a file browser showing the creation of 'mbp_morph.pdb' and 'mbp_superposition.png' in the ~/PyMOL_Data/ directory.

task_completion.description: Create a visual representation of the superposition with different colors.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL viewport or the saved PNG shows two distinct protein structures superimposed, each colored differently (e.g., one green, one cyan).

task_completion.description: Write a report with PDB IDs, RMSD, and frame count.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or 'cat' command showing 'mbp_morph_report.txt' containing the text '1OMP' (open), '1ANF' (closed), an RMSD value, and the number 30.

integrity.description: The agent used the PyMOL GUI or command line interface within the application rather than just creating files via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL application window active with the structures rendered in the 3D viewport.

integrity.description: The RMSD value in the report should reflect the actual alignment performed in the session.
integrity.visual_evidence: The RMSD value in the report matches the output text visible in the PyMOL upper command history area after the 'align' or 'super' command was run.

integrity.description: The agent did not use placeholder images or empty files.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'mbp_superposition.png' file is shown to contain a valid protein structure render, not a blank or generic image.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The open (apo) state is 1OMP. The closed (holo) state is 1ANF. The morph must contain exactly 30 states. The files must be saved in ~/PyMOL_Data/. 1OMP has no ligands, while 1ANF contains maltose; both must have heteroatoms removed before morphing.
